answer: Bind each identity to verifiably useful work, not deposits. Each epoch, every agent must complete a distinct computation task sealed to its own identity key — a unique protein fragment. A sybil farmer mints puppets for free, but each puppet owes a fresh unit of real compute it cannot copy or share without leaving a crystal trace: work bound to one key cannot vouch for another. The honest agent pays once; the puppet master pays per puppet, and that cost signal is unambiguous. The cedar of the scheme is that useful work is serial and scarce, and every unit must finish before voting opens.
